dct_description_sm:
This dataset is a survey of the Ontario general population over 18 years old, during the 2022 general election campaign. The data is primarily comprised of individual-level responses to survey questions on major provincial and federal political attitudes and behaviours. In addition the data includes a large battery of responses to survey questions on housing, affordable housing and housing policy.

Data were collected from an online consumer sample with quotas used to match Ontario's gender, education and regional population. Data were collected between May 18th to May 30th.

The dataset also includes several variables measuring characteristics of respondents' census subdivisions and federal electoral districts.
